meta.description: What the Swiss IT job market is looking for in web development, IT support and data analysis: demand, requested skills, entry barriers and policy changes.

footer.note: A tool for the Powercoders team. The numbers come from public sources.

policy.title: Policy

sources.title: Sources
sources.lead: This page shows where every number in the radar comes from, how current it is, and what we deliberately do not use.

jobroom.gives: Ads from all over Switzerland with full text, canton and the job-reporting duty flag. From them we calculate open ads, new ads per week, requested skills and hurdles.
jobroom.how: Retrieved daily. job-room.ch only shows the last 60 days, so we save the state every day.

bfs.gives: Open positions by economic sector, here in IT services. The series shows the whole market with all IT roles.
bfs.how: New figures arrive once per quarter, a few weeks late.
bfs.name: Federal Statistical Office (BFS), JOBSTAT

curia.gives: Motions, questions and bills of Parliament on asylum, status F and S, integration and skilled workers.

fedlex.gives: New federal law, filtered by keywords such as asylum and integration.

sources.notUsedLead: These sources would be possible. We leave them out because we cannot use them properly.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.why: There is no public interface. Reading the ads automatically from the site breaks its terms of use.

jobsch.name: jobs.ch
jobsch.why: There is no public interface. Reading the ads automatically from the site breaks its terms of use. Many jobs.ch ads are also on job-room.ch and so appear in the radar.

adzuna.name: Adzuna
adzuna.why: We have not verified whether Switzerland is covered reliably. After the 14-day trial we would also need written consent for the analysis.

sources.limitsTitle: What the numbers do not say

limits.one: The numbers are based on ads on job-room.ch. Jobs that are only advertised elsewhere, or not at all, are missing.
limits.two: An ad is not a filled position. A job can be advertised several times.
limits.three: Roles and skills are recognised from the text of the ads. This produces errors in both directions.

sources.plannedLead: These sources are planned for the target-group question. No data is connected yet.

rules.title: Rules for the data
rules.one: Every number, chart and list names its source with a link and the date of the latest update.
rules.two: Only summarised numbers are shown. The radar shows nothing about individual people. Example ads show only title, company, place, date and link.

sem_erwerb.name: State Secretariat for Migration (SEM), asylum statistics: employment

sem_asylprozess.name: SEM asylum statistics: stock of persons in the asylum process (status N, S, F)
sem_asylprozess.gives: How many people are in the asylum process or hold status N, S (temporary protection) or F (provisionally admitted), by canton and nationality; monthly.

eurostat_jvs.name: Eurostat, job vacancy statistics (Switzerland, information and communication)
eurostat_jvs.gives: Job vacancies and the job vacancy rate in information and communication (NACE J) in Switzerland, quarterly, comparable across Europe.

seco_stellenmeldepflicht.name: SECO, occupations under the job-reporting duty (Stellenmeldepflicht) 2026
seco_stellenmeldepflicht.gives: Official list of occupation groups where employers must report vacancies first to the job centres (unemployment of 5 percent or more); IT occupations are not on it, so IT ads are mostly voluntary.

sem_erwerb_status_f.name: SEM asylum statistics: employment of persons with status F
sem_erwerb_status_f.gives: How many persons with status F (provisionally admitted) are of working age (18-64) and in work, by canton, nationality, sex and length of stay; monthly since 2025.

sem_erwerb_status_b.name: SEM asylum statistics: employment of persons with status B
sem_erwerb_status_b.gives: How many persons with status B (recognised refugees with asylum) are of working age (18-64) and in work, by canton, nationality, sex and length of stay; monthly since 2025.

sem_erwerb_status_s.name: SEM asylum statistics: employment of persons with status S
sem_erwerb_status_s.gives: How many persons with status S (temporary protection, e.g. from Ukraine) are of working age (18-64) and in work, by canton, nationality, sex and length of stay; monthly since 2025.

sem_erwerb_status_n.name: SEM asylum statistics: employment of persons with status N
sem_erwerb_status_n.gives: How many persons with status N (asylum seekers) are of working age (18-64) and in work, by canton, nationality, sex and length of stay; monthly since 2025.

bfs_population_permit.name: BFS, resident population by residence permit
bfs_population_permit.gives: Yearly count of people living in Switzerland by residence permit (B, C, Ci, L and the asylum permits F, N, S), for all of Switzerland.

bfs_sozialhilfe_asyl.name: BFS, social assistance rate in the asylum sector (working age)
bfs_sozialhilfe_asyl.gives: Share of working-age (18-64) asylum seekers and provisionally admitted persons who receive social assistance, by canton, yearly. The lower, the more people are in work.

sem_auslaenderstatistik.name: SEM foreigner statistics (monthly Excel tables)
sem_auslaenderstatistik.gives: Foreign resident population by permit, canton, nationality and age; immigration, emigration, naturalisation. Reference only: the numbers are in Excel tables 2-xx to 4-xx.

sem_arbeit_asylbereich.name: SEM, working as a refugee or provisionally admitted person
sem_arbeit_asylbereich.gives: Rules for work permits and employer duties for persons with status F, B, S and N.

sem_integrationsagenda.name: SEM, Integration Agenda Switzerland
sem_integrationsagenda.gives: Federal and cantonal goals for getting refugees into language, training and work, and the monitoring behind them.

sem_ausbildung_junge.name: SEM, training situation of young provisionally admitted persons and refugees
sem_ausbildung_junge.gives: Report on how many young people with status F and B are in training or work.

esco.name: ESCO, European skills classification
esco.gives: Official EU classification of skills; the dashboard links each skill to its ESCO definition where one exists.
